notes: The two the's of the fruit ... of the ground are counted under rule 29: the one article morpheme stands on the rectum and takes the the before its own word, while the construct takes a supplied one.
The of between first and all is the rēʾšîṯ–kol relation and goes to the rectum kol (rule 19); no of is written between all and the fruit, so pərî keeps only the fruit.
The supplied object it after put is added, since the Hebrew writes no object morpheme (rules 30, 44).
The opening waw carries the frame's complementizer that under rule 45, the apodosis of DEU.26.1's protasis opening with its own waw.
